info.title: GenderAPI Public API
info.summary: Gender inference and phone validation endpoints.
info.description: API-owner-approved contract derived from the public English documentation and verified backend handlers. Gender values are probabilistic inferences, not verified identity. Publication remains controlled by the separate GEO release gate.

x-lifecycle-policy.canonicalTransport: Bearer authentication on POST operations; query-key on documented GET compatibility operations.
x-lifecycle-policy.compatibility: Existing legacy GET, authentication transports, JSONP or alternate response shapes, HTTP error mappings, and errno values remain operational until measured, announced, and migrated.
x-lifecycle-policy.breakingChange: Removing or changing an accepted request transport, operation, response shape, field type, HTTP/application-error mapping, or errno value is a breaking change.
sunsetSignaling: Sunset HTTP header where technically applicable
